subject: MAP: finalize runway + procurement cutover
body:
From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Rossi <elena@seasidehealth.com>
Cc: Marcus Li <marcus.li@healthops.io>
Date: Tue, 1 Dec 2026 15:12:00 -0800
Subject: MAP: finalize runway + procurement cutover

Hi Elena — great conversation today, thanks for the time. Attaching a revised Mutual Action Plan (MAP) based on our call: I condensed milestones and added a proposed procurement cutover date so your procurement team has a clear signature runway. Key highlights up front:

- Target close (commercial signature): 2027-01-20
- Procurement / legal signature deadline to hit that close: 2027-01-12 (internal procurement approval by 2027-01-08)
- Primary blockers: SOC 2 evidence (you mentioned a checklist), SSO audit, and the indemnity carve (legal redline)
- Milestone owners: Seaside (PO & legal) / Redwood (Soojin for commercial, Dylan for SRE onboarding, Neha for billing terms)

Please review the MAP and the three items highlighted in the first worksheet: (1) procurement steps with owner and contact, (2) required evidence and expected delivery dates, and (3) the proposed staggered rollout (pilot -> full org). If that runway looks realistic for you, we’ll lock the procurement cutoff and I’ll coordinate a quick legal handoff.

Attachments:
- Soo_jin_MAP_Draft_v2.xlsx (spreadsheet) - MAP with milestones and owners
- Seaside_RFP_Attachments.zip (zip) - includes their RFP PDF we discussed

Next steps I propose:
1) You confirm whether the 2027-01-12 procurement deadline is achievable for your team (reply by EOD Thu 12/3).
2) If yes, we’ll create a short procurement checklist and schedule a 30-min signature-runway call with procurement + legal next week.
3) Dylan will draft the onboarding SOW and target dates once procurement runway is confirmed.

Thanks — talk soon.

Best,
Soojin Lee
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
soojin_lee@redwood.ai
---

On Tue, 1 Dec 2026 at 17:05, Elena Rossi <elena@seasidehealth.com> wrote:

> 
> Hi Soojin — thanks for the recap and the MAP. Quick notes from procurement/legal side after a quick sync with Marcus:
> 
> - 2027-01-12 as the signature deadline is tight but possible. Procurement needs the SOC 2 evidence and an estimated SSO test window to lock on 1/08.
> - Legal expects to review a redline of the contract (we’ll send within 48 hours) but asked for a friendly-looking term for indemnity — can you flag a standard clause?
> - We’ll aim to get final PO approved by 1/15 if signatures go through on 1/12.
> 
> Marcus is on copy and will coordinate the RFP attachments and confirm internal reviewers. We’ll push to confirm feasibility by EOD Friday 12/3.
> 
> Thanks,
> Elena
> Director of Digital Ops
> Seaside Health
> ---

From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>
To: Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
Cc: Elena Rossi <elena@seasidehealth.com>, Marcus Li <marcus.li@healthops.io>
Date: Wed, 2 Dec 2026 09:26:00 -0800
Subject: RE: MAP: finalize runway + procurement cutover

Dylan / Neha — looping you both in so we can hit the runway if Seaside confirms. Short asks for internal alignment: 

- Dylan: can you draft a 2-page SOW outline (pilot success criteria, data handling, timeline for pilot -> org-wide) by EOD Thu 12/3? That will help procurement estimate the lift.
- Neha: please confirm billing terms we can commit to (net 30 vs net 45) and whether any ADJ (advance) is needed for pilot.

I’ve also attached a slightly cleaned MAP (v2) and noted the dependency matrix — the SOC 2 checklist items we can supply are in tab "Evidence". If procurement needs a datacenter/IP list for their security team, Dylan, please pull from the infra sheet and add to the SOW appendix.

If Elena confirms 1/12 is possible, I’ll book a 30-min procurement + legal alignment slot for Mon 12/6 (options: 10:00 or 15:00 PT). Please add availability in the calendar invite that I’ll send once Elena confirms.

Thanks — Soo

Attachment referenced: [Attachment: Soo_jin_MAP_Draft_v2.xlsx (spreadsheet)]

---

From: Marcus Li <marcus.li@healthops.io>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>, Elena Rossi <elena@seasidehealth.com>
Date: Thu, 3 Dec 2026 11:22:00 -0800
Subject: Re: MAP: finalize runway + procurement cutover

Thanks, everyone. Quick confirmation from my side:

- Procurement can target the 2027-01-12 signature cutoff provided we receive SOC 2 artifacts and the SSO test window by 2026-12-29.
- Legal will push an initial redline to Soojin and to Redwood legal by 2026-12-05; please confirm the DocuSign flow you prefer (one DocuSign envelope for the commercial + SOW, or separate envelopes).
- If Redwood can offer a short pilot discount (5%) that would make approval easier, procurement asked to see that in the SOW pricing appendix.

Elena, I’ll have our procurement lead email Soojin with a short list of evidence items this afternoon.

Marcus
Procurement Manager (acting)
Seaside Health

[End of thread]
